reading: F is true for a model id containing gpt- but neither oss nor gpt-4. True publishes apply_patch and withholds edit and write; false publishes edit and write and withholds apply_patch. V1 parity still uses the captured mock/mock-model, so its apply_patch leg remains excluded. V2 apply_patch scenarios now explicitly select openai/gpt-5-mock while other scenarios keep openai/mock-model by default. V2 disables the host patch plugin and AFT supplies the corresponding per-model gate; the V1 source fragments above remain unchanged.
